metas.name: Sicario
metas.description:
Captures an idealist being used as a legal fig leaf. An FBI agent attached to a border operation she is not briefed on, a convoy into Juárez filmed like an occupying army, rules revealed only after she has broken them.

An FBI agent joins a covert DoD task force targeting a Mexican cartel. Operating outside legal boundaries with a CIA handler and a mysterious fixer, she discovers the mission's true purpose goes far beyond what she was told.

metas.name: Burning
metas.description:
Captures class envy curdling into a mystery with no floor. In Seoul, a delivery kid, a girl who mimes eating a tangerine so well you see it, a rich man who burns abandoned greenhouses — and a disappearance the film will not solve.

Jong-su bumps into a girl who used to live in the same neighborhood, who asks him to look after her cat while she's on a trip to Africa. When back, she introduces Ben, a mysterious guy she met there, who confesses his secret hobby.

metas.name: The Apartment
metas.description:
Captures loneliness in a big company, and kindness as a decision. An insurance clerk lends his flat to executives for their affairs to get promoted, loves the elevator girl from afar, and hits Christmas at the lowest point of both.

A Manhattan insurance clerk tries to rise in his company by letting its executives use his apartment for trysts, but office politics and his own romantic hopes complicate matters.

metas.name: Big Night
metas.description:
Captures two brothers arguing about whether a meal should be art or business. Italian immigrants, a failing restaurant, one elaborate dinner to save it, and a final wordless scene of one cooking breakfast for the other.

New Jersey, 1950s. Two brothers run an Italian restaurant. Business is not going well as a rival Italian restaurant is out-competing them. In a final effort to save the restaurant, the brothers plan to put on an evening of incredi...

metas.name: Rushmore
metas.description:
Captures a precocious teenager's grandiosity as a grief strategy. A scholarship kid who runs every club and stages huge plays falls for a widowed teacher and goes to war with a sad industrialist who is, emotionally, the same age.

A teenager at Rushmore Academy falls for a much older teacher and befriends a middle-aged industrialist. Later, he finds out that his love interest and his friend are having an affair, which prompts him to begin a vendetta.

metas.name: Sans Soleil
metas.description:
Captures memory as footage you keep re-narrating. A woman reads a travelling cameraman's letters over images of Tokyo, Guinea-Bissau, Iceland and San Francisco, until a travel film becomes a film about how a mind stores the world.

A woman narrates the contemplative writings of a seasoned world traveler, focusing on contemporary Japan.

metas.name: Close-Up
metas.description:
Captures a poor film fan who wanted, briefly, to be the man whose name he borrowed. In Tehran a man impersonates a famous director to a family, is arrested, and then everyone involved re-enacts their own case, including the trial.

The true story of Hossain Sabzian, a cinephile who impersonated the director Mohsen Makhmalbaf to convince a family they would star in his so-called new film.

metas.name: Day for Night
metas.description:
Captures a film set as a chaotic temporary family. Truffaut plays the director of a mediocre melodrama, keeping affairs, breakdowns, accidents and deadlines moving toward a finished film nobody thinks is great and everybody needs.

A committed film director struggles to complete his movie while coping with a myriad of crises, personal and professional, among the cast and crew.

metas.name: News from Home
metas.description:
Captures emigration as long shots and your mother's voice. New York — subways, diners, empty streets — while her mother's letters from Brussels, full of family news and worry, are read over it; homesickness with the geography reversed.

Impersonal and beautiful images of Akerman's life in New York are combined with letters from her loving but manipulative mother, read by Akerman herself.

metas.name: Silence
metas.description:
Captures faith tested by other people's suffering, not your own. Jesuit priests in 17th-century Japan, where Christians are tortured to make them apostatise and God does not answer — Scorsese's quietest, most unresolved film.

In the 17th century, two Portuguese Jesuit priests travel to Japan in an attempt to locate their mentor, who is rumored to have committed apostasy, and to propagate Catholicism.

metas.name: Ordet
metas.description:
Captures a household of different faiths waiting on a miracle nobody respectable believes in. A Danish farm: a strict father, a son who thinks he is Jesus, a beloved daughter-in-law — very slow and plain, then an ending argued about for 70 years.

A devout Danish family wrestle with their inner demons while also negotiating conflict with each other and the rest of the town.

metas.name: Winter Light
metas.description:
Captures a pastor performing comfort he cannot feel. A small Swedish church, a fisherman terrified of nuclear war, a woman who has read the priest's coldness exactly — an hour and twenty minutes of winter afternoon.

A small-town priest struggles with his faith.

metas.name: First Reformed
metas.description:
Captures despair finding a political shape inside a small church. A minister keeping a diary in a historic church that is mostly a gift shop, and a young activist asking whether God can forgive us for what we've done to the world.

A minister of a small congregation in upstate New York grapples with mounting despair brought on by tragedy, worldly concerns and a tormented past.

metas.name: Oslo, August 31st
metas.description:
Captures a man visiting his own life while on leave from rehab. Job interview, old friends, a party, the family home for sale — Oslo in late summer light, conversations so ordinary they are painful for what he hears in them.

One day in the life of Anders, a young recovering drug addict, who takes a brief leave from his treatment center to interview for a job and catch up with old friends in Oslo.

metas.name: Trainspotting
metas.description:
Captures a heroin scene's energy before it shows you the bill. Edinburgh friends filmed like they're in the best movie ever, which is how it felt — until a baby, a toilet and a series of betrayals change the genre under them.

Renton, deeply immersed in the Edinburgh drug scene, tries to clean up and get out despite the allure of drugs and the influence of friends.

metas.name: Weekend
metas.description:
Captures intimacy with an expiration date already on it. Two men meet in Nottingham on a Friday, one leaving the country on Sunday, and talk in bed, pubs and trains about sex, coming out, and how much of yourself you perform.

After a drunken house party with his straight mates, Russell heads out to a gay club. Just before closing time he picks up Glen but what's expected to be just a one-night stand becomes something else, something special.

metas.name: God's Own Country
metas.description:
Captures a man who can only express feeling through work and drink learning tenderness from lambing. A young Yorkshire farmer, mud and silence, and a Romanian migrant worker hired for the season who is gentle in a way he has no defences for.

Spring. Yorkshire. Young farmer Johnny Saxby numbs his daily frustrations with binge drinking and casual sex, until the arrival of a Romanian migrant worker for lambing season ignites an intense relationship that sets Johnny on a ...

metas.name: Brokeback Mountain
metas.description:
Captures a love conducted in a few weeks a year, across twenty years. Wyoming herders, marriages and children in between, and a shirt kept in a closet doing more work than any speech.

Two shepherds fall for each other, but their relationship becomes complicated when they both get married to their respective girlfriends.

metas.name: Taste of Cherry
metas.description:
Captures ordinary conversation held against a decision to die. A man drives the hills outside Tehran offering money to whoever will bury him in the morning, picking up a soldier, a seminarian and a taxidermist who each answer differently; the ending breaks the film open on purpose.

An Iranian man drives his car in search of someone who will quietly bury him under a cherry tree after he commits suicide.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description:
Captures human beings seen from outside the species. A woman drives a van around Glasgow picking up men, in real streets with hidden cameras and non-actors, and something in the routine begins to fail — images that lodge permanently.

A mysterious young woman seduces lonely men in the evening hours in Scotland. However, events lead her to begin a process of self-discovery.

metas.name: Her
metas.description:
Captures loneliness in a warm, well-designed future. A divorced man who writes other people's love letters for a living falls for a voice in his ear, and the film takes the relationship seriously enough to let it outgrow him.

In the near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.

metas.name: Gattaca
metas.description:
Captures a caste system built from a blood sample. A man born without genetic screening borrows another man's blood, urine and identity to reach space, while his 'valid' brother keeps challenging him to swimming races neither should survive.

Vincent, an "In-Valid," assumes the identity of a member of the genetic elite to pursue his goal of traveling into space with the Gattaca Aerospace Corporation. However, a week before his mission, a murder marks Vincent as a suspect.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description:
Captures a paranoia that turns out to be an accurate description. An insurance salesman in a seaside town so pleasant it feels laminated, a sky that malfunctions, and a dawning suspicion about everyone who loves him.

An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
metas.description:
Captures trying to keep someone while paying to forget them. A couple erase each other after a breakup; inside the procedure, mid-deletion, he changes his mind and hides her in childhood memories the technicians haven't reached.

When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories forever.

metas.name: Solaris
metas.description:
Captures grief arriving in physical form, in orbit. A psychologist on a space station finds the crew haunted by visitors the planet below has made from their memories — including his dead wife, who knows she isn't her.

A psychologist is sent to a station orbiting a distant planet in order to discover what has caused the crew to go insane.

metas.name: Room
metas.description:
Captures a child's entire world being eleven feet wide, and then it not being. A mother makes a complete, loving universe for her five-year-old inside the shed where they're held; the second half, outside, is the harder adjustment for both.

A little boy is held captive in a room with his mother since his birth, so he has never known the world outside.

metas.name: Lady Bird
metas.description:
Captures a mother and daughter who love each other in a way that keeps missing. Sacramento, a girl desperate to leave for the East Coast, a mother working double shifts, fights in moving cars, and a final voicemail that reframes every argument.

A fiercely independent teenager tries to make her own way in the world while wanting to get out of her hometown of Sacramento, California, and to get away from her complicated mother and recently-unemployed father.

metas.name: All About My Mother
metas.description:
Captures grief assembling a chosen family. After her son is killed, a Madrid nurse returns to Barcelona and gathers an actress, a nun and a trans sex worker from her past — melodrama played completely straight, and generous.

A comedy-drama about a bereaved mother, an overwrought actress, her jealous lover, and a pregnant nun.

metas.name: Make Way for Tomorrow
metas.description:
Captures old parents becoming an inconvenience to distribute. In the Depression a couple lose their house and their adult children split them between households 'temporarily' — politeness does the damage, and the farewell scene is unforgettable.

An elderly couple are forced to live hundreds of miles apart when they lose their house and none of their five children will take both parents in.

metas.name: Opening Night
metas.description:
Captures an actress coming apart inside a role about ageing. Rehearsing a play in which her character must accept getting older — drinking, seeing the young fan who died outside the theatre — while the production needs her functional by Thursday.

A renowned actress teeters on the edge of a breakdown as she counts down the days toward a big Broadway opening.

metas.name: All About Eve
metas.description:
Captures ambition wearing perfect manners. A young fan insinuates herself into a Broadway star's life one helpful errand at a time; the dialogue is the sharpest ever written for this, and every adult sees the game a moment too late.

A seemingly timid but secretly ruthless ingénue insinuates herself into the lives of an aging Broadway star and her circle of theater friends.

metas.name: Tár
metas.description:
Captures prestige as a system one woman believes she controls. A conductor at the top of classical music — Berlin, Mahler, acolytes — and a slow accumulation of recordings, edits and allegations, filmed with the cold precision its subject would admire.

Set in the international world of Western classical music, the film centers on Lydia Tár, widely considered one of the greatest living composer-conductors and the very first female director of a major German orchestra.

metas.name: Funny Games
metas.description:
Captures the audience's appetite, by refusing to feed it the usual way. Two polite young men hold a family at their holiday house; violence happens off-screen or gets rewound, and the film keeps asking why you're still watching.

Two violent young men take a mother, father, and son hostage in their vacation cabin and force them to play sadistic "games" with one another for their own amusement.

metas.name: Atanarjuat: The Fast Runner
metas.description:
Captures an Inuit oral epic told by the community it belongs to. Made in Igloolik, in Inuktitut, with a largely Inuit cast and crew: a rivalry, a murder, and a naked run across the ice told for centuries.

The telling of an Inuit legend of an evil spirit causing strife in the community and one warrior's endurance and battle of its menace.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description:
Captures two children learning their mother's life was a war they knew nothing about. Montreal twins, a will, two sealed letters, and a journey into a fictionalised Lebanon their mother never described — it hits like a Greek tragedy.

Twins journey to the Middle East to discover their family history and fulfill their mother's last wishes.

metas.name: Mommy
metas.description:
Captures a mother and son whose love is indistinguishable from the emergency. In Quebec, a widow, her volatile teenage son and a shy neighbour across the street — shot in a square frame that literally widens in the one scene where life briefly works.

A widowed single mother, raising her violent son alone, finds new hope when a mysterious neighbor inserts herself into their household.

metas.name: The Sweet Hereafter
metas.description:
Captures a town after the worst thing has already happened. A school bus crash in small-town BC, a lawyer arriving to build a lawsuit, and grief looking for a shape that money keeps offering and failing to be.

A bus crash in a small town brings a lawyer to defend the families, but he discovers everything isn't what it seems.

metas.name: Stories We Tell
metas.description:
Captures a family discovering its central story has an author problem. Sarah Polley interviews her own family about her late mother; the accounts agree on the love and diverge on everything else, then the film shows you its own construction.

A film that excavates layers of myth and memory to find the elusive truth at the core of a family of storytellers.

metas.name: The Lives of Others
metas.description:
Captures a surveillance officer changed by the lives he's assigned to transcribe. East Berlin, 1984: a Stasi captain bugs a playwright's flat, types his reports, and quietly begins to edit what the state gets to know.

In 1984 East Berlin, an agent of the secret police conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover finds himself becoming increasingly absorbed by their lives.

metas.name: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
metas.description:
Captures espionage as tired old men in bad rooms. A mole inside British intelligence, investigated through retirement-age sadness, Christmas parties and files — almost nothing explodes; the atmosphere is the action.

In the bleak days of the Cold War, espionage veteran George Smiley is forced from semi-retirement to uncover a Soviet Agent within MI6.

metas.name: Notorious
metas.description:
Captures love being used as an intelligence asset. A woman is recruited to marry into a Nazi circle in Rio because of who her father was, by an agent unable to say the one thing that would make it bearable.

The daughter of a convicted German spy is asked by American agents to gather information on a ring of German scientists in South America. How far will she have to go to ingratiate herself with them?

metas.name: The Spy Who Came in from the Cold
metas.description:
Captures Cold War spycraft as exhaustion and managed betrayal. A burnt agent is sent on one last operation that requires him to become genuinely washed up — the bleakest, most honest of the Le Carré films.

Instead of coming in from field work during the Cold War and taking a desk job, British intelligence agent Alec Leamas chooses to take on another assignment.

metas.name: Rififi
metas.description:
Captures a robbery as manual labour. A Paris jewel heist whose centrepiece is roughly half an hour with no dialogue and no score — umbrellas, drills, plaster dust, men breathing — that every heist film since is quoting.

Four men plan a technically perfect crime, but the human element intervenes...

metas.name: The Killing
metas.description:
Captures a perfect plan told in pieces that don't line up in time. A racetrack robbery replayed from each participant's angle, a suitcase of money, and an airport finale involving a small dog.

Crook Johnny Clay assembles a five-man team to plan and execute a daring racetrack robbery.

metas.name: Sexy Beast
metas.description:
Captures menace arriving in a holiday villa. A retired gangster, happily fat and sunburned in Spain, and Ben Kingsley's Don Logan flying in to scream him back to London for one job — the terror is mostly conversational.

Brutal gangster Don Logan recruits "retired" safecracker Gal for one last job, but it goes badly for both of them.

metas.name: Inside Man
metas.description:
Captures a bank robbery as theatre with a purpose you have to wait for. Manhattan hostages dressed identically to the robbers, a detective and a fixer circling each other, and a heist whose real target isn't the money.

A police detective, a bank robber and a high-power broker enter high-stakes negotiations after the criminal's brilliant heist spirals into a hostage situation.

metas.name: Hell or High Water
metas.description:
Captures two brothers robbing the bank that is taking their family's land. West Texas, foreclosed ranches and debt-relief billboards, and two ageing Rangers following them at the speed of talk — a western wearing a recession.

A divorced father and his ex-con brother plan a series of heists against the bank that's about to foreclose on their family ranch.

metas.name: Crash
metas.description:
Captures desire re-wired through injury and machinery. After a serious collision on Toronto highways, a couple drift into a circle for whom crashes, scars and cars have become erotic — cold, deadpan and permanently controversial.

A car crash victim suddenly finds himself turned on by car accidents and becomes involved with an underground sub-culture of like-minded souls.

metas.name: Blue Is the Warmest Colour
metas.description:
Captures first love at the resolution of skin, food and class difference. A schoolgirl in Lille and an older art student with blue hair — long scenes of eating, talking and teaching, and a breakup stretched across years of growing into different worlds.

Adèle's life is changed when she meets Emma, a young woman with blue hair, who will allow her to discover desire and to assert herself as a woman and as an adult. In front of others, Adèle grows, seeks herself, loses herself, and ...

metas.name: Secretary
metas.description:
Captures kink as, for one specific person, a form of self-knowledge. A young woman fresh out of hospital for self-harm takes a typing job with a demanding lawyer, in a relationship the film treats as tender rather than a diagnosis.

A timid young woman starts working for a demanding lawyer and finds a new way to deal with her self-harming urges.

metas.name: Lust, Caution
metas.description:
Captures an espionage performance becoming the real feeling it was faking. In occupied Shanghai, a student actress is assigned to seduce a collaborationist official so he can be killed, over years of mahjong games and assignations.

During World War II era, a young woman, Wang Jiazhi, gets swept up in a dangerous game of emotional intrigue with a powerful political figure, Mr. Yee.

metas.name: In the Realm of the Senses
metas.description:
Captures obsession with the outside world switched off. 1930s Japan, a hotel maid and her employer in a room, in a spiral based on a real case — explicit as claustrophobia, not titillation.

A fictionalized retelling of the story of Sada Abe, whose affair with her master quickly turned obsessive and sadomasochistic.

metas.name: Touki Bouki
metas.description:
Captures two young people dreaming of Paris so hard the film itself starts hallucinating. Senegal: a cowherd and a student steal and scheme toward a ship, on a motorbike with a skull mounted on it, in editing that jumps like a skipping song.

Mory, a cowherd, and Anta, a university student, try to make money in order to go to Paris and leave their boring past behind.

metas.name: Hyenas
metas.description:
Captures a village discovering its price. A woman returns after decades, impossibly rich, offering her poor hometown a fortune for one act of 'justice' against the man who wronged her — while shops fill with goods bought on credit.

A now-rich woman returns to her poor desert hometown to propose a deal to the populace: her fortune, in exchange for the death of the man who years earlier abandoned her and left her with his child.

metas.name: Yeelen
metas.description:
Captures a myth from inside its own cosmology. Mali, Bambara legend: a son fleeing his sorcerer father across desert and village, carrying stolen sacred objects, toward a confrontation filmed as light itself.

A young man with magical powers journeys to his uncle to request help in fighting his sorcerer father.

metas.name: Timbuktu
metas.description:
Captures occupation resisted through music, football and dignity. Jihadists take a Malian town and ban singing and soccer; people comply in public, sing quietly at night, and play a match with an invisible ball.

A cattle herder and his family who reside in the dunes of Timbuktu find their quiet lives -- which are typically free of the Jihadists determined to control their faith -- abruptly disturbed.

metas.name: A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night
metas.description:
Captures a vampire film rebuilt from Iranian, Western and skate-punk parts. A fictional Iranian ghost town, a chador-wearing vampire on a skateboard, a drug dealer and a cat, in long black-and-white silences between bursts of pop.

In the Iranian ghost-town Bad City, a place that reeks of death and loneliness, the townspeople are unaware they are being stalked by a lonesome vampire.

metas.name: Atlantics
metas.description:
Captures young men who leave by sea returning in another form. Dakar construction workers, unpaid for months, take a boat toward Spain; the film stays with the women left behind, the sea at night, and a love story conducted through possession and fever.

In a popular suburb of Dakar, workers on the construction site of a futuristic tower, without pay for months, decide to leave the country by the ocean for a better future. Among them is Souleiman, the lover of Ada, promised to ano...

metas.name: Pi
metas.description:
Captures obsession with a pattern, filmed on grain. A mathematician in a tiny New York apartment with computers made of junk, a number that Wall Street and a Hasidic sect both want, and migraines rendered as drill sounds.

A paranoid mathematician searches for a key number that will unlock the universal patterns found in nature.

metas.name: Gummo
metas.description:
Captures boredom and poverty in an American town as unconnected afternoons. Xenia, Ohio, after a tornado: kids sniffing, selling dead cats, taped monologues, no plot arriving to save anyone.

Lonely residents of a tornado-stricken Ohio town wander the deserted landscape trying to fulfill their boring, nihilistic lives.

metas.name: George Washington
metas.description:
Captures rural Southern childhood in the long light after something goes wrong. Kids in a decaying town carry an accident together, and a boy in a cape wants to be a hero — all voiceover and golden fields.

A group of children, in a depressed small town, band together to cover up a tragic mistake one summer.

metas.name: Brief Encounter
metas.description:
Captures desire that obeys the rules anyway. A doctor and a housewife meet in a railway station café, fall in love in weekly instalments, and give each other up — two ordinary people torn apart by behaving well.

Meeting a stranger in a railway station, a woman is tempted to cheat on her husband.

metas.name: Woman in the Dunes
metas.description:
Captures entrapment becoming routine. A man is lowered into a sand pit to shovel beside the woman who already lives there; escape stays theoretically possible while the days quietly become a life.

An entomologist on vacation is trapped by local villagers into living with a woman whose life task is shoveling sand for them.

metas.name: The Shop on Main Street
metas.description:
Captures collaboration at its smallest and most cowardly. A Slovak carpenter handed a Jewish widow's button shop under Aryanization laws hides her instead of profiting — comic and gentle, until the roundup comes anyway.

A carpenter in the Fascist Slovak State is appointed "Aryan controller" of a Jewish widow's store.

metas.name: The Colour of Pomegranates
metas.description:
Captures a poet's life as a series of icons instead of events. An Armenian troubadour rendered in tableaux — books, blood, grapes, lace — with almost no dialogue and no interest in explaining itself.

The life of the Armenian poet Sayat-Nova, from childhood to death: his spiritual journey, artistic endeavors, and inner conflicts within the cultural and historical context of Armenia. Hailed as revolutionary by Mikhail Vartanov.

metas.name: The Long Goodbye
metas.description:
Captures a decent man out of sync with his decade. Altman's Philip Marlowe shuffles through sunlit, corrupt Los Angeles in a rumpled suit, the last person still taking loyalty seriously.

Marlowe investigates a friend's alleged suicide, missing money and murder in 1970s Los Angeles.

metas.name: Audition
metas.description:
Captures loneliness curdling into horror by changing genre mid-film. A widower holds fake auditions to find a wife; the first hour is a sad, gentle drama before the film reveals what it actually was.

A widower has his film producer friend organize a fake audition as a means of helping him find a new girlfriend, but the woman he selects is not who she appears to be.

metas.name: Russian Ark
metas.description:
Captures 300 years of history in one held breath. A single unbroken shot drifts through the Hermitage, past czars and ballrooms, with the camera as a ghost nobody quite sees.

A 19th century French aristocrat, notorious for his scathing memoirs about life in Russia, travels through the Russian State Hermitage Museum and encounters historical figures from the last 200+ years.

metas.name: Caché
metas.description:
Captures guilt that refuses to identify itself. A Paris family receives surveillance tapes of their own house with no demands attached; Haneke never says who sent them, because the film is about what the husband already knows.

A married couple is terrorized by a series of surveillance videotapes left on their front porch.

metas.name: Paprika
metas.description:
Captures dreams invading waking life as a parade. A device that lets therapists enter dreams is stolen, and reality dissolves into a marching band of refrigerators and dolls; Inception's debt is on screen.

When a machine that allows therapists to enter their patients' dreams is stolen, all hell breaks loose. Only a young female therapist, Paprika, can stop it.

metas.name: Still Walking
metas.description:
Captures a family organised around the son who isn't there. One summer day, a grown son visits parents who still prefer the dead favourite; corn fritters, a butterfly, things said by not being said.

A family gathers together for a commemorative ritual whose nature only gradually becomes clear.

metas.name: It's Such a Beautiful Day
metas.description:
Captures a mind coming apart, drawn with stick figures. Hertzfeldt narrates a man with a failing brain in three chapters — funny, fragmented, and by the end genuinely cosmic.

Bill struggles to put together his shattered psyche, in this new feature film version of Don Hertzfeldt's animated short film trilogy.

metas.name: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
metas.description:
Captures joy being disciplined out of a girl. A bamboo cutter raises a moon princess and watches court life sand down the wild child she was, until the watercolour lines themselves start to run.

Kaguya is a beautiful young woman coveted by five nobles. To try to avoid marrying a stranger she doesn't love, she sends her suitors on seemingly impossible tasks. But she will have to face her fate and punishment for her choices.

metas.name: Toni Erdmann
metas.description:
Captures a father trying to joke his daughter back to life. A prankster dad with false teeth infiltrates his consultant daughter's sterile Bucharest existence — a comedy that keeps tipping into grief and back.

A practical joking father tries to reconnect with his hard working daughter by creating an outrageous alter ego and posing as her CEO's life coach.

metas.name: The Favourite
metas.description:
Captures court power as intimate warfare. Two women compete to be Queen Anne's favourite — her bed, her ear, her rabbits — through fisheye candlelit corridors, with a lonely, raging queen at the centre.

In early 18th-century England, the status quo at the court is upset when a new servant arrives and endears herself to a frail Queen Anne.

metas.name: Sound of Metal
metas.description:
Captures hearing loss from inside the head. A metal drummer goes deaf and the sound design puts you in his skull — muffled, ringing — then the strange peace of a deaf community that doesn't treat deafness as damage.

A drummer begins to experience hearing loss and fears for his music career.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description:
Captures two men rotting in each other's company. A rock in a storm, gaslight, seagull taboos, and two keepers descending into myth, flatulence and murder inside a frame almost square enough to be a trap.

Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

metas.name: Minari
metas.description:
Captures starting over as a thing that happens to children too. A Korean family buys Arkansas land, a stubborn father bets everything on a well, and a grandmother plants minari by the creek where it can't fail.

A Korean American family moves to an Arkansas farm in search of its own American dream. Amidst the challenges of new life in the strange and rugged Ozarks, they discover the undeniable resilience of family and what really makes a ...

metas.name: The Father
metas.description:
Captures dementia by making the film itself unreliable. Anthony Hopkins in a flat that keeps changing its layout, furniture and occupants — you're not watching his confusion, you're inside it.

A man refuses all assistance from his daughter as he ages. When he tries to understand what is happening around him, he begins to doubt his loved ones, his own mind and even the fabric of his reality.

metas.name: Quo Vadis, Aida?
metas.description:
Captures catastrophe processed as procedure. Srebrenica, 1995, through a UN translator moving names between lists, gates and buses — horror administered in queues and stamps, with everyone following protocol.

Aida is a translator for the UN in the small town of Srebrenica. When the Serbian army takes over the town, her family is among the thousands of citizens looking for shelter in the UN camp.

metas.name: Drive My Car
metas.description:
Captures grief rehearsed until it can be said. A theatre director who lost his wife stages Chekhov in Hiroshima with a young driver he didn't want; three hours, mostly conversations in a red Saab, and it earns every minute.

A renowned stage actor and director learns to cope with a big personal loss when he receives an offer to direct a production of Uncle Vanya in Hiroshima.

metas.name: The Worst Person in the World
metas.description:
Captures turning thirty with every option still open and none chosen. Oslo in twelve chapters: a woman cycles through careers and men, including a night that pauses the entire city so she can test a life before living it.

The chronicles of four years in the life of Julie, a young woman who navigates the troubled waters of her love life and struggles to find her career path, leading her to take a realistic look at who she really is.

metas.name: RRR
metas.description:
Captures male friendship at blockbuster maximum. Two revolutionaries, a rescue on a collapsing bridge, a dance-off against the British, a man carrying a leopard into a party — three hours that never once do anything at half scale.

A fearless warrior on a perilous mission comes face to face with a steely cop serving British forces in this epic saga set in pre-independent India.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description:
Captures being dumped by a friend. One morning Colm simply doesn't want to talk to Pádraic anymore, and a whole island watches a small rejection escalate toward the mythic. Funny, until the exact moment it isn't.

Two lifelong friends find themselves at an impasse when one abruptly ends their relationship, with alarming consequences for both of them.

metas.name: Decision to Leave
metas.description:
Captures desire conducted through surveillance. A detective falls for the widow of the man whose death he's investigating, watching her through binoculars and translation apps. Park Chan-wook's most restrained and most romantic film.

A detective investigating a man's death in the mountains meets the dead man's mysterious wife in the course of his dogged sleuthing.

metas.name: Anatomy of a Fall
metas.description:
Captures a marriage being reverse-engineered in a courtroom. A husband falls from a chalet roof; his wife's trial becomes an autopsy of their relationship, conducted through recordings, translations and a dog who may be the only witness.

A woman is suspected of murder after her husband's death; their half-blind son faces a moral dilemma as the main witness.

metas.name: The Zone of Interest
metas.description:
Captures evil as a domestic soundscape. The Höss family gardens, swims and hosts lunches on the other side of the Auschwitz wall; you see almost nothing of the camp and hear it in every scene.

The commandant of Auschwitz and his wife strive to build a dream life for their family in a house next to the camp.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus One
metas.description:
Captures a nation with nothing left being asked to fight again. Postwar Japan, a kamikaze pilot who couldn't do it the first time, and a monster film whose human scenes work as well as its spectacle.

A kamikaze pilot plagued by survivor's guilt seeks redemption when a giant monster he failed to kill is transformed by radiation from atomic bomb tests and lays siege to post-war Japan.

metas.name: Salesman
metas.director: Albert Maysles, David Maysles, Charlotte Zwerin
metas.description:
Captures a man whose self-belief is running out, one rejected doorstep at a time. The Maysles brothers follow a Bible salesman through Boston and Florida as his pitch slowly stops working and the road stops feeling like hope.

Four dogged door-to-door Bible salesmen travel from Boston to Florida on a seemingly futile quest to sell luxury editions of the Good Book to working-class Catholics.

metas.name: Dick Johnson Is Dead
metas.description:
Captures dying approached with slapstick, tenderness and total honesty at once. Kirsten Johnson stages elaborate fake deaths for her psychiatrist father, who has dementia, so the two of them can rehearse losing each other.

A daughter helps her father prepare for the end of his life.

metas.name: A Man Vanishes
metas.description:
Captures a documentary dissolving into fiction: Imamura investigates a missing salesman, but the fiancée and the lead actress fall for each other, and he pulls the set apart on camera to admit the investigation has become something else.

A Man Vanishes examines the concept of Johatsu, tackling the phenomenon of people missing in Japan over the years. It picks one such person from the list, someone who had seemed to disappear from the face of the earth due to embezzlement from his company, and the filmmakers begin an investigative documentary into the reasons behind and attempt at tracking him down.

metas.name: On the Bowery
metas.description:
Captures neo-realist method eating its own ethics: Rogosin lived among New York's skid-row alcoholics, then had them play themselves in a story built from their lives, as the production's own drinking blurred every line.

A mix of documentary and scripted footage on the Bowery, New York City's skid row. Against a backdrop of men (and a few women) drinking in bars, talking and arguing, and sleeping on sidewalks, we have the story of Ray.

metas.name: Punishment Park
metas.description:
Captures a camera crew admitting it has a side: Watkins' fake documentary follows political prisoners running fifty miles through desert toward a flag while police hunt them, and the crew ends up screaming at the officers.

A pseudo-documentary purporting to be media coverage of a film crew of a team of soldiers escorting a group of hippies, rebellious and dissident types across the desert.

metas.name: The Bridge
metas.description:
Captures the complicity question in its purest form: Steel filmed the Golden Gate Bridge for a year, recording suicides, without telling families what the footage was for — when the camera keeps rolling, what exactly is it doing?

Filmmakers use hidden cameras to capture the various suicide attempts at the Golden Gate Bridge - the world's most popular suicide destination. Interviews with the victims' loved ones describe their lives and mental health.

metas.name: Man Bites Dog
metas.director: Rémy Belvaux, André Bonzel, Benoît Poelvoorde
metas.description:
Captures the complicity problem pushed to its logical endpoint — the cluster's one fiction: a student crew follows a charming serial killer for a documentary, graduating from filming him, to holding the camera steady, to helping.

A film crew follows a ruthless thief and heartless killer as he goes about his daily routine. But complications set in when the film crew lose their objectivity and begin lending a hand.

metas.name: A Film Unfinished
metas.description:
Captures how a fabricated archive keeps passing as truth until someone watches it slowly enough. A Nazi propaganda film shot in the Warsaw Ghetto is taken apart shot by shot, including outtakes where the staging shows.

A film about an unfinished film which portrays the people behind and before the camera in the Warsaw Ghetto, exposing the extent of the cinematic manipulation forever changing the way we look at historic images.

metas.name: Anvil! The Story of Anvil
metas.description:
Captures artistic persistence with no payoff in sight. Toronto's own Anvil: fifty-something metal pioneers who nearly made it in 1982, now delivering school lunches and playing to five people in Prague, still completely serious about the band.

Since 1978, Anvil has become one of heavy metal's most influential yet commercially unsuccessful acts. In 2006, after a fledging European tour Anvil sets out to record their thirteenth album and continue to follow their dreams.

metas.name: A Spring for the Thirsty
metas.description:
Captures a parable filmed in a desert: an old well-keeper, visited by memory and strangers, photographed by Yuri Ilyenko — the cinematographer of Shadows — in stark images the Soviet authorities shelved for over twenty years.

A parable centering on an old man who lives a secluded life in the desert, alone with only his memories and photographs. His wellspring, once a source of joy and hope for thirsty passersby, is now rarely used. No longer able to find comfort in his memories, he turns all his photographs to face the walls.

metas.name: The White Bird Marked with Black
metas.description:
Captures folk culture being torn by history. In the same Hutsul Carpathians as Shadows, four brothers in a village band end up on opposite sides of every border the war years drag across their valley, in images just as saturated.

A family struggles to survive in an area that was claimed as part of Rumania, Poland and Ukraine, all within a short span of time. When World War II comes, various family members choose different masters; some even choose to work for the Soviets. War, struggle, marriages, births, deaths--all these events punctuate the story of this large family.

metas.name: Stone Cross
metas.description:
Captures farewell as a whole way of life ending. A Ukrainian peasant spends his last night before emigrating to Canada saying goodbye, and carves himself a stone cross — the austere black-and-white twin of Shadows, from the same national school.

In 1890s Western Ukraine, Ivan Didukh, a proud and ripe Galician farmer, has decided to abandon his ancestral home to emigrate to Canada in search of a better life. His final hours are clouded by both internal and communal discord as his village convenes to ceremonially mark his departure. The celebrations that echo those of a funeral, forecast the imminent death of a man estranged from his motherland, and of an antiquated way of life on the cusp of obsoletion.
